facts.headline: Mind AI Token Release: Another Step Toward Autonomous Trading?
facts.summary: The Mind AI token release ($MA) is another move toward autonomous, AI-driven trading agents in DeFi. It raises the question of what changes when market participants are software that never sleeps, can't be held accountable, and may soon act well beyond trading.
